name: TubeSync
description: Archives YouTube channels and playlists as media files on a schedule — your subscriptions, downloaded and organized.
compose:
services:
  tubesync:
    image: ghcr.io/meeb/tubesync:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:4848"
    environment:
      TZ: "UTC"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
      - /downloads:/downloads
    restart: unless-stopped
